questions.question: Describe thin-film solar PV material and their advantages and disadvantages. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Thin-film solar photovoltaic (PV) -2
  • Advantages: any three – 1.5
  • Disadvantages: any three – 1.5
  • Thin-film solar photovoltaic (PV) materials are semiconductor materials deposited in
  • very thin layers onto substrates such as glass, metal, or plastic. Unlike conventional
  • crystalline silicon solar cells, thin -film solar cells use much less semiconductor
  • material, making them lightweight and flexible.
  • Advantages: Lightweight, flexible, lower manufacturing cost, better performance in
  • low light
  • Disadvantages: Lower efficiency, larger installation area required, shorter lifespan,
  • lower energy density
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

  • Maintain safe working area
